<svg viewBox="0 0 1104 2130" style="min-width:900px" role="img" aria-label="使う場面：主体 ・ 目的 ・ 成功したときの保証 ・ 最低限の保証" class="dsvg"><style data-dsvg="dark">.dsvg .canvas{fill:var(--dsvg-area-fill,#FFFFFF)}.dsvg .note{fill:var(--dsvg-ink-soft,#5B6B66);font-size:11px}.dsvg .box.focus{fill:var(--dsvg-accent-bg,#D5E6E3);stroke:var(--dsvg-accent,#0D5C55)}.dsvg .title{fill:var(--dsvg-ink,#111D1A);font-size:13px;font-weight:700}.dsvg .box{fill:var(--dsvg-box-fill,#F3F7F5);stroke:var(--dsvg-accent,#0D5C55)}.dsvg .label{fill:var(--dsvg-ink,#111D1A);font-size:12px}@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .dsvg,.dsvg:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--dsvg-area-fill:#22302D;--dsvg-ink-soft:#9DADA8;--dsvg-accent-bg:#173330;--dsvg-accent:#6CC9B8;--dsvg-ink:#E6EEEB;--dsvg-box-fill:#16211E}}:root[data-theme="dark"] .dsvg{--dsvg-area-fill:#22302D;--dsvg-ink-soft:#9DADA8;--dsvg-accent-bg:#173330;--dsvg-accent:#6CC9B8;--dsvg-ink:#E6EEEB;--dsvg-box-fill:#16211E}</style><rect data-dsvg="canvas" class="canvas" x="0.0" y="0.0" width="1104.0" height="2130.0" fill="#FFFFFF" rx="8"/>
<text class="note" x="20" y="22" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#5B6B66">#</text>
<text class="note" x="88" y="22" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#5B6B66">主体</text>
<text class="note" x="236" y="22" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#5B6B66">目的</text>
<text class="note" x="484" y="22" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#5B6B66">成功したとき</text>
<text class="note" x="792" y="22" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#5B6B66">最低限</text>
<rect class="box focus" x="16" y="32" width="60" height="75" fill="#D5E6E3" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="2" rx="5"/>
<text class="title" x="26" y="57" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#111D1A">U0</text>
<rect class="box" x="84" y="32" width="140" height="75" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="94" y="57" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">利用者</text>
<rect class="box" x="232" y="32" width="240" height="75" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="242" y="57" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">AI に書かせた成果物を、正しいと確</text>
<text class="label" x="242" y="74" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">かめた状態で使い続ける</text>
<rect class="box" x="480" y="32" width="300" height="75" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="490" y="57" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">使っている instance が、いまの契約のすべ</text>
<text class="label" x="490" y="74" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">ての rule で verified（機械の検証と、変</text>
<text class="label" x="490" y="91" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">更に入れた AI ・ 人の判定の記録）である</text>
<rect class="box" x="788" y="32" width="300" height="75" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="798" y="57" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">入力が変わった判定と、検証できなかった rule</text>
<text class="label" x="798" y="74" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">は、verified として見えない</text>
<rect class="box focus" x="16" y="113" width="60" height="75" fill="#D5E6E3" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="2" rx="5"/>
<text class="title" x="26" y="138" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#111D1A">U1</text>
<rect class="box" x="84" y="113" width="140" height="75" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="94" y="138" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">作者（人か AI）</text>
<rect class="box" x="232" y="113" width="240" height="75" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="242" y="138" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">Concrete スキーマを作る</text>
<rect class="box" x="480" y="113" width="300" height="75" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="490" y="138" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">Concrete が Abstract の版と拡張の契約に</text>
<text class="label" x="490" y="155" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">従い、Agent が案内に従って instance を書</text>
<text class="label" x="490" y="172" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">ける</text>
<rect class="box" x="788" y="113" width="300" height="75" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="798" y="138" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">契約に従わない Concrete は、違反した</text>
<text class="label" x="798" y="155" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">rule と一緒に取り込めない理由として出る</text>
<rect class="box focus" x="16" y="194" width="60" height="143" fill="#D5E6E3" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="2" rx="5"/>
<text class="title" x="26" y="219" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#111D1A">U2</text>
<rect class="box" x="84" y="194" width="140" height="143" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="94" y="219" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">作者</text>
<rect class="box" x="232" y="194" width="240" height="143" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="242" y="219" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">Concrete スキーマを変える（繰り</text>
<text class="label" x="242" y="236" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">返した注意を x-prompt に上げる</text>
<text class="label" x="242" y="253" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">ことを含む）</text>
<rect class="box" x="480" y="194" width="300" height="143" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="490" y="219" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">変更に、変更後の姿での全 instance の状</text>
<text class="label" x="490" y="236" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">態・ 状態が変わった instance ・ 人が見る</text>
<text class="label" x="490" y="253" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">ものが出る。x-prompt を変えた欄の前の AI</text>
<text class="label" x="490" y="270" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">の判定は効かなくなり、取り直すまで</text>
<text class="label" x="490" y="287" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">unverified として出る。変更の記録（意</text>
<text class="label" x="490" y="304" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">図・ 目的の参照）が一緒に残り、セッションの</text>
<text class="label" x="490" y="321" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">参照は手元の索引に残る</text>
<rect class="box" x="788" y="194" width="300" height="143" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="798" y="219" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">取り込むまで、いまの契約 ・ x-prompt と</text>
<text class="label" x="798" y="236" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">instance の状態は変わらない</text>
<rect class="box focus" x="16" y="343" width="60" height="58" fill="#D5E6E3" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="2" rx="5"/>
<text class="title" x="26" y="368" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#111D1A">U3</text>
<rect class="box" x="84" y="343" width="140" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="94" y="368" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">作者</text>
<rect class="box" x="232" y="343" width="240" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="242" y="368" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">Abstract の新しい版に</text>
<text class="label" x="242" y="385" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">Concrete を合わせる</text>
<rect class="box" x="480" y="343" width="300" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="490" y="368" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">機械で直せる箇所は直り、残りは案内に従って直</text>
<text class="label" x="490" y="385" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">る</text>
<rect class="box" x="788" y="343" width="300" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="798" y="368" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">移せなかった箇所は一覧で返り、いまの</text>
<text class="label" x="798" y="385" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">Concrete は壊れない</text>
<rect class="box focus" x="16" y="407" width="60" height="58" fill="#D5E6E3" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="2" rx="5"/>
<text class="title" x="26" y="432" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#111D1A">U4</text>
<rect class="box" x="84" y="407" width="140" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="94" y="432" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">提供側（Core を</text>
<text class="label" x="94" y="449" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">作る側）</text>
<rect class="box" x="232" y="407" width="240" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="242" y="432" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">Abstract の新しい版を、移し方と</text>
<text class="label" x="242" y="449" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">一緒に出す</text>
<rect class="box" x="480" y="407" width="300" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="490" y="432" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">作者が U3 を案内どおりに終えられる</text>
<rect class="box" x="788" y="407" width="300" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="798" y="432" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">前の Abstract の版は中身が変わらず、それ</text>
<text class="label" x="798" y="449" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">を申告する Concrete は検証を通り続ける</text>
<rect class="box focus" x="16" y="471" width="60" height="92" fill="#D5E6E3" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="2" rx="5"/>
<text class="title" x="26" y="496" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#111D1A">U5</text>
<rect class="box" x="84" y="471" width="140" height="92" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="94" y="496" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">AI の Agent</text>
<rect class="box" x="232" y="471" width="240" height="92" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="242" y="496" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">instance を作る</text>
<rect class="box" x="480" y="471" width="300" height="92" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="490" y="496" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">決定権が人の欄は人の入口から来た値のまま書か</text>
<text class="label" x="490" y="513" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">れ、rule ごとの結果がそろい、violated が</text>
<text class="label" x="490" y="530" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">無い。変更の記録（意図 ・ 目的の参照）が一</text>
<text class="label" x="490" y="547" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">緒に残り、セッションの参照は手元の索引に残る</text>
<rect class="box" x="788" y="471" width="300" height="92" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="798" y="496" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">violated ・ error の rule が根拠付きで</text>
<text class="label" x="798" y="513" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">返る。必須の欄が空なら、根拠「必須の欄が空」</text>
<text class="label" x="798" y="530" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">の機械の violated として返る</text>
<rect class="box focus" x="16" y="569" width="60" height="75" fill="#D5E6E3" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="2" rx="5"/>
<text class="title" x="26" y="594" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#111D1A">U6</text>
<rect class="box" x="84" y="569" width="140" height="75" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="94" y="594" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">AI の Agent</text>
<rect class="box" x="232" y="569" width="240" height="75" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="242" y="594" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">既存の instance を変える</text>
<rect class="box" x="480" y="569" width="300" height="75" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="490" y="594" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">参照と導出値が整合したまま変わる。変更の記録</text>
<text class="label" x="490" y="611" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">（意図 ・ 目的の参照）が一緒に残り、セッシ</text>
<text class="label" x="490" y="628" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">ョンの参照は手元の索引に残る</text>
<rect class="box" x="788" y="569" width="300" height="75" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="798" y="594" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">参照が壊れる ・ 導出値が合わない変更は</text>
<text class="label" x="798" y="611" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">violated として返り、取り込めない理由に出</text>
<text class="label" x="798" y="628" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">る</text>
<rect class="box focus" x="16" y="650" width="60" height="92" fill="#D5E6E3" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="2" rx="5"/>
<text class="title" x="26" y="675" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#111D1A">U7</text>
<rect class="box" x="84" y="650" width="140" height="92" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="94" y="675" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">AI の Agent</text>
<rect class="box" x="232" y="650" width="240" height="92" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="242" y="675" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">契約の変更で violated になった</text>
<text class="label" x="242" y="692" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">instance を、同じ変更の中で直す</text>
<rect class="box" x="480" y="650" width="300" height="92" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="490" y="675" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">直した instance が変更後の契約で</text>
<text class="label" x="490" y="692" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">violated を持たず、元の意味が保たれてい</text>
<text class="label" x="490" y="709" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">る。変更の記録（意図 ・ 目的の参照）が一緒</text>
<text class="label" x="490" y="726" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">に残り、セッションの参照は手元の索引に残る</text>
<rect class="box" x="788" y="650" width="300" height="92" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
